mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo , user_id AS userId , user_pw AS userPw , user_name AS userName , DATE_FORMAT(reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS regDate FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_pw = #{userPw}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, user_pw, user_name, reg_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userName}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT user_no AS userNo -- 사용자 번호 , user_id AS userId -- 사용자 아이디 , user_name AS userName -- 사용자 이름 , reg_date AS regDate -- 등록일 , reg_user AS regUser -- 최초 등록자 , mod_date AS modDate -- 수정일 , mod_user AS modUser -- 마지막 수정자 , `role` AS role -- 권한(SYSTEM/ADMIN/USER) , status AS status -- 계정상태(ACTIVE / DISABLED) FROM users ORDER BY user_no DESC
